method.data: trades_raw 2026-11-10 (Bybit linear public archive): event_ts (ms), side (taker), price, size; 51 symbols; DuckDB read of the lake parquet, archive row order kept within a millisecond (file_row_number)
method.split: FIT = durations / prints with start and end in [00:00, 12:00) UTC; TEST = [12:00, 24:00); robustness TEST-exCPI drops durations or prints starting in [13:00, 16:00); registered verdicts use the full TEST half
method.levels: order = maximal run of consecutive prints with the same ms and taker side; arrival event = distinct ms; primary levels: H-MS1 events, H-MS2 prints, H-MS3 orders; print durations of 0 ms set to 0.5 ms
method.classes: major = BTC ETH SOL XRP DOGE; tradfi = CL BZ XAU XAG QQQ NVDA TSLA MSTR COIN CRWV GOOGL; alt = the rest (incl. BNB)
method.H-MS1: part 1: KS of raw TEST durations vs an exponential with the sample mean, p < 0.01, for EVERY symbol (Anderson-Darling at 1% reported); part 2: exponential, weibull, gamma, lognormal, gengamma, burr12, loglogistic (MLE, loc 0) and 2-3 component exponential mixtures (EM) fitted on FIT, winner = highest TEST log-likelihood (AIC on TEST reported), holds if a non-exponential family wins for > 80% of symbols; part 3: x = d / s with s the causal trailing 30-min mean duration, ACD(1,1) with exponential / Weibull / generalized-gamma unit-mean innovations fitted on FIT (after a 30-min warm-up), filtered through the whole day; residuals e = x / psi on TEST; holds if KS(e vs exponential) <= 0.5 KS(raw TEST durations vs exponential) for > 80% of symbols, using the ACD with the best FIT log-likelihood; supports = all three parts; p = max of the three one-sided binomial p-values (part 1 and 3 vs 0.8, part 2 vs 0.8)
method.H-MS2: notional = price x size (USD); CSN: x_min minimises KS over 80 candidates (tail sizes geometric from the upper half to 50 points), MLE alpha_pdf, zeta = alpha_pdf - 1; bootstrap p (B = 200 on TEST prints, 50 elsewhere), power law not rejected if p > 0.1 (CSN); Vuong vs a log-normal truncated at x_min, preferred if R > 0 and two-sided p < 0.05; Hill on the same tail; per symbol on TEST prints; supports = zeta in [1, 2] and not rejected for > 70% of symbols AND preferred for > 50%; p = max of binomial p vs 0.7 and 0.5
method.H-MS3: order signs (+1 buy, -1 sell) per half; ACF lags 1-1000 averaged in log bins (8 per decade); power law = OLS of log ACF on log lag, exponential = OLS of log ACF on lag, over bins whose ACF exceeds the 2/sqrt(n) noise band of that half (rule added after the CARV/KAS smoke test, before the full run: near-zero noisy bins dominated the log MSE); both fitted on FIT, held-out MSE of log ACF on the TEST bins above the TEST band; gamma = power-law fit on TEST; per symbol with >= 20k prints in the day: power preferred (lower held-out MSE) and 0 < gamma < 1; PACF lags 1-50 (Durbin-Levinson) with +-1.96/sqrt(n) bands, count of significant positive lags 11-50 (reported, not in the success line); Hurst = DFA-1 of 1 s signed notional on TEST (scales 10-4320 s), pooled = mean over the >= 20k symbols, 95% CI by bootstrap over symbols; supports = share > 0.8 and the CI excludes 0.5 from above; p = max(binomial p vs 0.8, bootstrap p of mean H <= 0.5)
method.H-MS4: notional volume per 10 s and per 60 s clock bin; positive bins: gamma, gengamma, lognormal fitted on FIT, TEST log-likelihood (zero bins share reported, identical for all families); distribution holds if max(gengamma, lognormal) > gamma; ACF of log(1 + v / median positive FIT v), lags 1-360 (10 s) / 1-120 (60 s), log bins, power vs exponential as in H-MS3 (FIT fit, TEST held-out MSE); co-movement: Spearman of v and |log return| (last price per bin, carried forward) on TEST > 0; a symbol passes if all three hold at both intervals; supports = > 80% of symbols; p = binomial p vs 0.8
method.H-MS9: arrival-event durations; xgboost survival:aft (hist, depth 6, eta 0.05, subsample 0.8, early stopping on the last 20% of FIT after warm-up) with distributions normal / logistic / extreme x training scale {0.8, 1.5}; sigma of the density re-estimated by MLE on the validation part; chosen config = best validation log-likelihood, refitted on all of FIT with 1.25x the best rounds; features at the start of each duration: log of the last 5 durations, log trailing 30-min scale, trailing 10 s / 60 s counts, |log return| over the last 10 / 100 events and 10 s / 60 s, signed-notional imbalance of the last 10 events and 60 s, last event sign / log notional / log prints, effective spread proxy |last buy - last sell| / price, L2 spread / touch imbalance / 5 bp depth imbalance / log 5 bp depth (12 ob200 symbols, 250 ms grid, point in time), hour of day; comparator = the ACD(1,1) with the best TEST log-likelihood (conservative); per-duration log-lik difference in seconds units, class value = mean over symbols of the per-symbol mean, 95% CI by a 5-minute block bootstrap shared across symbols (B = 2000); supports = difference > 0 with CI excluding 0 in >= 2 of 3 classes; p = second-smallest class bootstrap p
method.holm: Holm over the five summary p-values; supports only if the literal criterion holds and the Holm-adjusted p < 0.05; criterion met but Holm p >= 0.05 -> inconclusive; criterion not met -> contradicts
